content.short: Delysium is the first playable AAA MMO game on Web3, fully decentralized and player-owned.
content.description: Delysium is the first playable AAA MMO game on Web3, fully decentralized and player-owned. The game features a cyberpunk-inspired open-world environment with multiple game modes in which players can compete. Players can earn loot boxes in events, containing tokens, NFTs, and other items that can be used or sold on a large, player-run marketplace.
